title: Court sessions; quarters.
bodyText: Sessions of the court shall be held at such places as the court shall determine, subject to section 603-14.
bodyHtml: §571-82  Court sessions; quarters.  Sessions of the court shall be held at such places as the court shall determine, subject to section 603-14. [L 1965, c 232, pt of §1; Supp, §333-37; HRS §571-82; am L 1973, c 211, §1(j)]
